input: app.use('/ftp', serveIndexMiddleware, serveIndex('ftp', { icons: true })) // vuln-code-snippet vuln-line directoryListingChallenge

context.guidance: Require authentication on every route that returns Personal Data, and check on each request that the authenticated Data Principal owns the record or holds a role authorised for it. Do not let an identifier supplied in the path or body decide ownership. Apply the check to every method on the route, because Rule 6(1)(b) requires access to the resources holding Personal Data to be controlled.

value.fix: Remove the unauthenticated directory listing. Delete `app.use('/ftp', serveIndexMiddleware, serveIndex('ftp', { icons: true }))`, or if the share must stay, mount it only behind an authentication middleware that rejects unauthenticated requests before serve-index or static file handling runs. Add an authorization check on every request (GET, HEAD, and any other method) that confirms the authenticated user owns the requested file or holds a role permitted to access it, and do not trust a filename, ID, or path segment supplied by the client to determine ownership. Replace the open directory listing with an explicit allowlist of files that are meant to be public, and keep files containing personal data out of the served directory entirely. Remove the `vuln-code-snippet` markers only if this is not an intentional training target.
